Topic 3.2: Reading readiness skills

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Reading readiness skills. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: when (2HRS) a) Demonstrate left-right eye and drop from left to right in a digital clip. reading?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Demonstrate top-down activity and guided to turn pages from right to left. turn pages orientation skills when reading. •

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Demonstrate top-down activity and guided to turn pages from right to left. turn pages orientation skills when reading. •
   In simple words: practise until you can demonstrate top-down activity and guided to turn pages from right to left. turn pages orientation skills when reading. •. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Reading readiness skills using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Reading readiness skills in the examples.
2. Explain Reading readiness skills to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Reading readiness skills.
4. Show that you can: Demonstrate top-down activity and guided to turn pages from right to left. turn pages orientation skills when reading. •

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading readiness skills using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Reading readiness skills important for a PP1 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
